idea.title: Feira o guarda-sol
idea.text: feira livre: ele dança embaixo do guarda-sol da barraca de pastel; o topete atravessa o guarda-sol

script.title: Guarda-chuva no topete
script.premise: No ponto de ônibus na chuva, ele dança brega e abre um guarda-chuva preto automático; a copa pousa inclinada no alto do topete e a água da chuva escorre da borda num fio sobre o ombro dele, que segue sério.
script.gag_without_sound: o topete é tão alto que o guarda-chuva fica torto em cima dele e a água cai no ombro

beats.extras: pessoas esperando o ônibus olham a rua ou o celular

beats.action: aperta o botão do guarda-chuva automático acima da cabeça; a copa abre, pousa inclinada no topo do topete e a água escorre da borda no ombro esquerdo dele

script.end_state: guarda-chuva aberto, torto no alto do topete, fio de água caindo no ombro esquerdo, rosto sério

en.gag_sentence: At a rainy São Paulo bus stop he does his signature brega step, then opens a black automatic umbrella whose canopy lands tilted on top of his rigid pompadour, so the rainwater pours off its low edge onto his shoulder.
en.location: the edge of a short bus-stop shelter on a São Paulo avenue in heavy rain, wet asphalt reflecting car lights, late afternoon
en.location_map: Center: he stands at the front edge of the shelter roof, half under it. Frame-left: the shelter bench with waiting people. Frame-right: the wet avenue with passing cars. Background: rain falling in visible streaks.
en.position: at the front edge of the shelter, centered, chest square to the lens, the full pompadour and the falling rain behind him visible
en.signature_pose: left hand flat on his belly, right hand holding a closed black automatic umbrella by its J-handle, tip pointing at the ground, feet together
en.extras_tasks: two people on the bench read their phones, one stands looking down the avenue for the bus, one holds a plastic bag over her head and watches the cars
en.props: exactly one black automatic umbrella, closed, held by its J-handle in his right hand, tip pointing at the ground
en.hands: He has exactly two hands: left hand flat on his belly, right hand on the umbrella handle.

stages.text: He holds the signature pose from the start frame; breathing lifts the chest, one slow blink.
stages.end_state: same pose, eyes into the lens.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

stages.text: Real-time, at 95 BPM: he shifts his weight onto his left foot, heel first; his hips sway once to frame-left and once to frame-right on the beat; the closed umbrella in his right hand swings 10 cm with the hips.
stages.end_state: feet together, umbrella closed, chest square to the lens.
stages.facing: chest within 30° of the lens while the hips sway, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

stages.text: He raises the closed umbrella by its shaft straight up above his head and presses the auto-open button on the handle with his right thumb; the black canopy springs open and comes to rest on the top of the pompadour, which props it up 45 cm above his head and tilts it 20° toward frame-left; rainwater runs off the low edge of the canopy in a thin steady stream onto his left shoulder.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: umbrella open and tilted on the top of the pompadour, a stream of water pouring onto his left shoulder.

stages.text: Everything settles and holds; the stream keeps pouring onto his left shoulder; he stares into the lens. The final frame matches the end frame.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: umbrella tilted on the pompadour, water pouring onto his soaked left shoulder, deadpan.

en.end_change: he holds the open black umbrella by its shaft with his right hand; the canopy rests on the top of the pompadour, 45 cm above his head, tilted 20° toward frame-left; a thin stream of rainwater pours from its low edge onto his soaked left shoulder; deadpan
en.end_props: exactly one open black umbrella, shaft in his right hand, canopy resting on the top of the pompadour, tilted 20° toward frame-left
en.props_lock: Exactly one black umbrella for the whole clip: closed in his right hand at the start, open and tilted on top of the pompadour at the end.
en.lighting: Overcast rainy late afternoon, cool 6500K daylight, wet reflective surfaces, headlights glinting on the asphalt.
